messages:
Priya (CS): heads-up — stack of tickets about free-trial credits not showing up after customers redeem promo code REDWOOD2025 :frowning:
Liam (Growth): ah shoot. we just launched that campaign earlier today. any example account ids?
Priya (CS): two sample accounts: acct_8271 and acct_9923. customers say flow completes successfully but credits are 0. API returns success but balance unchanged.
Owen (Billing): can you paste the API response from the repo step? often we see a backend grant step failing separately.
Priya (CS): here's a caller trace from the frontend console (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/promos/redeem
{"code":"REDWOOD2025","user_id":"acct_8271"}
200 OK
{"status":"redeemed","grant_id":"","message":"redemption recorded, pending grant"}
```
Priya (CS): notice grant_id is empty.
promo-bot: automated check: campaign REDWOOD2025 status=inactive, start_date=2026-05-01T00:00:00Z, end_date=2026-06-01T00:00:00Z
Nina (DevEx): that explains it — the campaign start_date is in the future (timezone / UI bug?). Growth thought it went live now.
Liam (Growth): omg I set the start based on my local timezone in the admin UI and didn't realize it serializes UTC incorrectly. my bad.
Owen (Billing): if campaign is inactive the redemption record can still be created (we allow queued redemptions) but the grant service will skip creating credits if campaign.active=false. that explains empty grant_id.
Priya (CS): what are recommended immediate actions? customers are complaining.
Nina (DevEx): short term: flip campaign active to true and update start_date to now. longer term: add validation in UI to warn when start_date > now or when admin timezone differs.
Liam (Growth): can I flip it? I don't have permission to toggle billing grants.
Owen (Billing): I can toggle and run a backfill for affected redemptions. but need the list of redemption_ids. Priya can export from the support dashboard.
Priya (CS): exported CSV attached in ticket: redemption_ids [r_1201, r_1202, r_1203] for those two accounts and a few others.
Owen (Billing): on it. steps I'll run:
- set campaign.active = true
- set start_date = now (UTC)
- run grant backfill for redemption_ids from CSV
I expect credits to be applied within ~10 minutes after backfill.
Liam (Growth): also looks like max_per_user was left unset (null) which caused some clients to hit a surprising limit in earlier tests. we should default to 1 and surface that in the UI.
Nina (DevEx): agree. action items: add default value for max_per_user=1, add UI warning for future start_date, and add a small integration test in the promo pipeline that exercises redeem->grant end-to-end.
Priya (CS): replying to affected customers now: "We've identified a setup issue with the promo campaign (start date not live). We're applying credits manually and will confirm shortly. Apologies." :thumbsup:
Owen (Billing): backfill finished for r_1201..r_1208, grant_ids populated, credits visible for acct_8271 and acct_9923. sent receipts to customers.
Priya (CS): great, closing tickets after confirmations.
Liam (Growth): retro note — I created the campaign using the Growth quick-create flow. I'll update the runbook and add a checklist: confirm 'active' + check timezone conversion before launch.
Nina (DevEx): I'll open a small Eval to monitor failed-grant events and page if >5 in 10 minutes.
Priya (CS): thanks everyone. moving to followups. :white_check_mark:
